title: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 13 Jesus came to Kenya, A study of his image

sense.text:
“Take heed that no man deceive you.” These were among the scriptures taken through Sierra Leone and Uganda, and over there they were new: the people asked why this understanding was not taught to them years ago. Don’t take any of these scriptures for granted.

For Christ to say take heed that no man deceive you, he obviously had to leave a description of himself, biblical clues, to prepare us and help us, so that we ourselves would never be deceived.

“For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.” Christian commentaries like to bring up such people as Jim Jones or David Koresh, but the operative word is many. Many is not one, not two, not five; many means thousands.

Examine history: the time of slavery and of colonialism. Many Europeans went throughout the continent of Africa teaching that they are Christ. At the Berlin Conference of the late 1800s the Europeans divided Africa up between the Portuguese, the Dutch, the British, the Germans, the Spanish and the French; they all took a piece, and they all pushed the doctrine that they are Christ. That is the many who came in his name and deceived many.

precepts.why:
This was the famous scripture in Sierra Leone: the description Christ left of himself so we would not be deceived. “His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow”: the hair on his head and the hair on his face were white like wool. Wool is a texture. There are two basic types of hair on the earth, thin straight hair and wool, afro hair. His hair was fully white, not gray.

“And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace”: in Sierra Leone the brothers literally had to buy brass, a menorah of brass, and burn it in front of the people so that they could grasp what that meant. “And his voice as the sound of many waters”: he spoke very, very loud.

In Sierra Leone this had to be drilled seven, eight, ten times before the people could grasp it; within a minute somebody would raise a hand and ask, so what color is Jesus? Uganda caught it quicker. Revelation 1:14 shuts down all the lies, and with Daniel 10:5-6 it is one of the two popular scriptures that describe the Messiah.

“For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached”: we read the description of Jesus in Revelation 1:14-15, and here Paul says if one comes preaching another Jesus. The disciples never preached a Caucasian Jesus.

“Or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted”: a false Jesus comes with another spirit and another gospel. “Ye might well bear with him”: and the way we bear well with them is by rebuking people in the scriptures.

“And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God.” Everybody says, oh yeah, he came in the flesh. Well, if he came in the flesh, what color was his flesh? Ask them and they will say either white or nobody knows. So what, was Christ running around Jerusalem invisible? Was he polka dot?

“And this is that spirit of antichrist.” When the Europeans went throughout Africa teaching that they are Christ, that was the spirit of antichrist, because they rejected the biblical description of him, with white wool hair and skin like it burned in the furnace, and gave you a European Jesus with red pink skin and yellow thin hair. “And even now already is it in the world.”

What is the other spirit of 2 Corinthians 11:4? “Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits.” The spirit that is in the world today, this Christianity spirit, is a seducing spirit. It seduces us to break God’s laws; that is what it does.

And what is the other gospel? We think the gospel should be simple, but evil has corrupted it. “I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel”: our people were removed unto another gospel.

“Which is not another”: they were using the same biblical text the apostles were using, but doing something different with the scriptures. “But there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.” That is what they do: read them the scriptures on color and they say, no, that’s his emotions, his inner feelings; the wool hair represents righteousness, that’s not really what he looked like. That is perverting the gospel.

sense.text:
In Matthew 24 Christ goes into a brief synopsis of the history that would come upon the Israelites, our fathers. “When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place”: Christ is calling the white man, the Roman Empire, the abomination of desolation. Jesus Christ the Saviour, who according to some of you never gave an ill word, called Rome the abomination of desolation.

“Whoso readeth, let him understand”: he is saying go precept upon precept. If you don’t know what Daniel wrote, you won’t know what Christ was talking about.

“Then let them which be in Judea flee into the mountains”: he was telling the Israelites, run for your lives, leave Jerusalem, run deeper into Africa. Don’t come down off the housetop to take anything out of the house; don’t go back from the field for your clothes. Run.

“And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!” Why? Because Rome besieged Jerusalem and caused a seven-year famine, and there was no food in Jerusalem to eat. Deuteronomy 28 shows why Christ said woe to them that are with child.

“But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day”: Israel had that doctrine about the sabbath day, don’t fight on it; some of them didn’t learn from the Maccabees.

“For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.” What occurred in 70 AD also occurred in the time of Babylon, so Christ is going far beyond 70 AD here; he is talking about something greater. “Except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened.”

“Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not.” This is what happened in Kenya back in July: a Kenyan pastor paraded a white man before his church, saying this is Jesus Christ who has descended from heaven as a result of a miracle, and the whole church was jumping and dancing. Half the city believed that dude was Jesus the Christ, in his Greek toga, a crackhead, a Charles Manson look-alike, and nobody peeped it. That Edomite needs to be set on fire and that negro needs to be whooped.

Our brothers and sisters in Kenya have obviously never read the Bible, to believe that this is Jesus the Christ. Revelation 1:14 shuts down all these lies, and you will never see the Christian apologetics, not even those dumb urban apologetics, speak against this. That is how you know they are all full of it.

“For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets”: this goes back to the antichrist, totally contrary to the Bible. The false prophets are there to substantiate the false Christ.

“And shall shew great signs and wonders”: write that word science next to it. It is not talking about the fake faith healings. If they had power they would walk through an AIDS ward and heal; why don’t they go into the hospital and heal everybody in it? In the book of Acts, Peter’s shadow passing over people healed them. They are all fake and phony, every last one. This is talking about the white man’s science: a leg missing, guess who can give you a new leg; your teeth fell out, guess who can give you new teeth; you’re blind, guess who can give you an eye. This is why they believe that they are God.

“Insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect”: their signs and miracles would be so powerful they would almost deceive the very elect.

precepts.why:
What is the abomination of desolation standing in the holy place? Daniel was prophesying about Rome. “And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week”: Rome made a covenant with the Israelites to allow us to sacrifice, for a short time. “And in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease”: that is what Rome did. “And for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate”: he shall make Jerusalem desolate.

Read the verse above it. “And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself”: Daniel is prophesying about Christ being sacrificed, and he did not die for himself; he died for the nation of Israel. “And the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary”: that is Rome, the Roman Empire.

“Even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.” What was determined upon us occurred: we were destroyed as a nation. With Daniel in hand you understand what Christ was talking about in Matthew 24:15.

This is why Christ said woe unto them that are with child. “The Lord shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth”: Rome. Their capital was Italy and their symbol was the eagle. “A nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand”: the language of Rome was Latin, L-A-T-I-N, not Spanish, Latin. “A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young.”

“The increase of thy kine”: the word kine means cattle. “And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fenced walls come down”: this is the seven-year siege.

“And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters”: there was no food in Jerusalem to eat. That is why Christ said woe unto them that are with child in those days.

The same thing occurred in the time of Babylon. “And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness.” The siege and the famine happened in the time of Babylon, and it happened again in the time of Rome.

People get simple, especially these Christian apologetics, dumb as a rock, saying that only happened once. No. “And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.” The curses that came upon us are the sign that we are the Israelites, and they are upon our seed for ever.

So many of these things are more than onefold or twofold; some are threefold, fourfold, because they occurred from captivity to captivity to captivity. What happened in the time of Rome is not recorded in detail in the Bible, because most of what was written, the epistles, came before 70 AD; the book of Revelation is one of the few written after it, around 96.

Here is the precept for the great signs and wonders. “And he doeth great wonders, so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men”: the same great wonders of Matthew 24:24, and here is the science. Hiroshima and Nagasaki, August 6 and August 9 of 1945, World War II: they dropped the atom bomb. That is making fire come down from heaven.

“And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles”: notice the wording. It didn’t say science there, it said miracles, and that is what it is talking about: the fire from heaven, the great wonders of verse 13. “Which he had power to do in the sight of the beast”: the white man.

sense.text:
“And there appeared another wonder in heaven; and behold a great red dragon”: this great red dragon is talking about Esau, Esau coming up in power.

“Having seven heads and ten horns”: the seven heads are Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia and Great Britain. The ten horns are the ten common markets, also called the EU, the European Economic Community; NATO is the military side of it and the EU is the economic side of it. Write them down: Belgium, France, Germany, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Denmark, Ireland, the United Kingdom and Greece. There are more than that, but these are the main ones.

precepts.why: Why is the great red dragon Esau? “And the first came out red, all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.” Esau came out red.
But it says dragon. “I am a brother to dragons”: dragons are wicked men. So the great red dragon is the red man, Esau, the wicked men coming up in power.

sense.text:
“And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns”: this is the same beast that is mentioned in chapter 12, and in chapter 12 it gives you his color, red. Here it calls him a beast, and people read that word and say it is a monster, an alien. No. The book of Revelation is a huge metaphor, a parable; that is why you have to read the Old Testament writings.

“And upon his heads the name of blasphemy”: Revelation 17 gives you the name of blasphemy.

“And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard”: many Christian commentaries reference Daniel 7. The Greeks had the animal symbol of the leopard; Alexander the Greek wore a leopard-skin hat on his head. In Daniel 7 you are given four major empires, and the first two, Babylon and Persia and Media, were not Edomite nations. But Revelation 13 is telling you of one race of people, divided into seven major kingdoms with ten smaller kingdoms in their support. Like unto a leopard: those are the Greeks.

“And his feet were as the feet of a bear”: in Daniel 7 the bear was the symbol of the Persians and Medes, but these are not Persians nor Medes, these are Edomites; they took on their characteristics. Russia is famous for the bear symbol today. “And his mouth as the mouth of a lion”: in Daniel 7 Babylon had the symbol of the lion, and in this day and age Britain took on that symbol.

“And the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority”: this dragon is Satan. He gave that power to Rome, the empire that was ruling in the time of Christ, and they have held on to it since the Renaissance.

precepts.why: The beast is not a monster or an alien. “I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.” Mankind themselves are beasts.

Here is the name of blasphemy. “And I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast”: scarlet is red, a red-colored beast. “Full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns”: still the same beast.

“And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.” Take notice that the first word is mystery. It says mystery because you would never believe in your wildest dreams that this white man, who everybody and your mama loves, is the devil on earth. You say, no, not them; they give us food stamps, they give us welfare, they give us public assistance; impossible. God is saying no, it’s them.

Didn’t Christ call him that in Matthew 24? He called Rome the abomination of desolation. Here John is calling them the abominations of the earth: the same group, the same people.

How do we know the dragon that gave the beast his power is Satan? “The devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world, and the glory of them; And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me.”

Satan offered Christ all the kingdoms of the world if he would bow down and worship him, because that power was given to Satan, to make you a ruling king, a leader. He obviously gave it to Rome.

sense.text:
“And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death”: write this down, Rome fell in 193 AD, under the hand of Septimius Severus. “And his deadly wound was healed”: 1453, the Renaissance era, Rome came back into power. That is the time they were getting all the ones they called Moors out of Spain, out of Europe.

What we read from verse 3 down is what Esau did as they started conquering systematically; America has not come into power yet in this part of the chapter. “And all the world wondered after the beast”: all the world wondered after the white man.

“And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast”: they worshipped Satan. “And they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?” Remember the Inquisition: they were getting us all out of Europe, chasing us. Those of us they captured they put in slavery, and a lot of our people fled down deeper into Africa. They called us Moors, and they were hunting and chasing us.

Verses 5 and 6 go together, and the precepts 1 Maccabees 1:44-50, 1 Maccabees 3:48 and 2 Thessalonians 2:4 go with them. Write that in your notebook.

“And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies”: they spoke against the scriptures. For the biblical reference you have to go back to their predecessors, the Greeks. “And power was given unto him to continue forty and two months”: write this down, forty and two months is three and a half years, which is 350 years.

“And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.” What they did was paint themselves as God, as Christ, as the angels; they set themselves up as God.

precepts.why:
This is the season of our forefathers’ Feast of Dedication, when the Maccabees rededicated the temple, so reference them and what they went through. This gives you an idea of a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies.

“Moreover king Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom, that all should be one people”: democracy all over again. “And every one should leave his laws: so all the heathen agreed according to the commandment of the king. Yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion, and sacrificed unto idols, and profaned the sabbath.”

“For the king had sent letters by messengers unto Jerusalem and the cities of Juda that they should follow the strange laws of the land, And forbid burnt offerings, and sacrifice, and drink offerings, in the temple; and that they should profane the sabbaths and festival days.” They were to set up chapels of idols, sacrifice swine’s flesh, leave their children uncircumcised, “To the end they might forget the law, and change all the ordinances. And whosoever would not do according to the commandment of the king, he said, he should die.”

So what the Greeks did, Esau following after them in Rome did the same thing, and as the Renaissance got under way they followed the same thing.

Speaking great things and blasphemies: “And laid open the book of the law, wherein the heathen had sought to paint the likeness of their images.” The Greeks started to paint themselves as Adam, as Jacob, as the twelve tribes, as Jeremiah, as Isaiah, Micah and Daniel. They started putting their images in the scriptures as our forefathers. That is why it was paramount for them to take the books of the Apocrypha out of the regular Bible.

“That he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is!” The secrets of wisdom many times have double meanings. Keep that in mind for 2 Thessalonians 2:4: it has a first meaning in the time of the Greeks and Rome, and a meaning for this day and age.

“Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come”: that day is the second coming of Christ. “Except there come a falling away first”: before the second coming of Christ the Israelites have to fall away into captivity. “And that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition”: the son of hell.

“Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped”: this is talking about the white man. This is that great mouth speaking blasphemies: they would oppose everything written and exalt themselves above all that is called God.

“So that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.” Here is the duality. When the Greeks took over the temple they set up idols in it, Jupiter, Zeus: they showed themselves that they are God. Rome did the same thing. So the first meaning is exactly what it says: they set themselves up in the temple, showing themselves that they are God, and Paul was making reference to what Rome would do in 70 AD as they were destroying it. We often bring it out for this day and age too.

This goes right along with Revelation 13. “I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake”: the great words, the same mouth speaking great things. The horn is America.

“I beheld even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame”: this refers to America, that little horn, because Babylon was not burned. Daniel saw the exact same thing the Lord showed to John: that little horn speaking great things.

People often ask what is this tabernacle. “Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.” The tabernacle that was being built was the temple, wherein the Israelites gathered together. So they blasphemed his name and his tabernacle.

sense.text:
“And it was given unto him to make war with the saints”: to him, still Edom, this great red dragon with seven heads and ten horns. Verse 7 gives us a lot in one verse. Esau, Edom, made war with the twelve tribes of Israel, the two kingdoms. From 1453 they cast us out from Rome, Spain and Portugal, where we were ruling, and we were on the run. Some of us they captured; most of us fled into Africa and the Caribbean islands.

But they weren’t finished. In 1492 they said there is another remnant of Israelites on the other side of the world, let’s get them: Ferdinand and Isabella funded Christopher Columbus, and he took an armada of soldiers with him. What do you need soldiers for on an expedition? That was the northern kingdom. Then before the 1600s they went into Africa and made deals with the Arabs and the Hamite nations for the southern kingdom: get them out of there, we’ll pay you. They brought us over here to serve chattel slavery. Chattel is just another word for cattle; they treated us like animals. Those of us with knowledge, wisdom and understanding they killed, but they left the children alive and raised them up like brute beasts, unable to read, unable to write. And those of us who remained behind in Africa, they colonized.

“And to overcome them”: they overcame us in slavery and colonialism. “And power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations”: they didn’t stop there. Britain went over to China and ruled for a time; that is the Boxer Rebellion you see in the Jet Li movies, the Chinese fighting to kick the British out, and Hong Kong was given back in ’98. But over in Africa they have no might, no power, nothing.

“And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him”: pause right there. After they overcame the saints, the twelve tribes of Israel, and began to systematically take down the world, all the earth worshipped him. Worship is a thing based upon religion. Remember verse 3: the deadly wound healed, and all the world wondered after the white man. Once they conquered us they instituted us worshipping them, and as you read further down John explains what they did.

“He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity”: here is the judgment for verses 7 and 8. We read it and isolate it by itself, but it is making reference to verse 7: he made war with the saints, the twelve tribes of Israel, and overcame us, enslaved us and colonized us. This is the judgment Christ is uttering. “He that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword”: because they were killing millions of us.

“Here is the patience and the faith of the saints”: the saints of verse 7, Israel.

precepts.why: Who are the saints? “He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him.” The word even means indeed: his saints are indeed the children of Israel. Not all nations on the earth are saints. We are the saints of the Lord.

Here is the proof of how he overcame the saints, one of the curses that would befall the twelve tribes. “Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people”: that is slavery. And what is heavy about that verse is that it is the sons and daughters taken; the parents stayed behind. “And thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long.” You have these dumb Israelites who don’t know the Bible saying there are no Israelites in Africa; they are just as dumb as the group that says there are no Israelites of the northern kingdom on this side of the world. Two dummies who need to get in a room together and play dominoes.

“And there shall be no might in thine hand”: no military might, no economic might, no political might. We used to ask, when we thought we were Africans, why didn’t they come get us? God says they would have no might to get us.

“The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up”: this is colonialism, for the Israelites that remained behind. That is the Berlin Conference of 1884, when they sat down and divided the entire continent of Africa up between the French, the Spanish, the Italians, the British, the Germans, the Belgians and the Portuguese.

sense.text:
“And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth”: this one is America. As they conquered us they also fought one another: they kicked some of the Spanish out, kicked some of the French out, fought Britain in the War of Independence; and those that remained formed themselves into a more perfect union, the United States of America of 1776.

“And he had two horns like a lamb”: America has a dual political system, the Republicans and the Democrats. They try to make themselves sound like a Christian society; they seem Christian. “And he spake as a dragon”: because the things they put out are satanic, freedom of religion for example. But all those laws they set up in their constitution, the amendments some of our fathers died for, were used by the Most High to benefit the rising of the twelve tribes of Israel. Could we teach what we are teaching now and get away with it otherwise? They would have had laws set up to kill us all.

“And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him”: that was Rome. America is based upon Roman ethics. Rome followed Greece, but it says Rome and not Greece because Alexander united all the Edomite nations, while Rome began to bring other nations into their military; Cornelius was a Roman centurion, and he was not an Edomite.

“And causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed”: the Renaissance. Notice the Roman numerals on the dollar bill, the Latin words on it, novus ordo seclorum, e pluribus unum, annuit coeptis. The days of the week, the months and the planets are all based upon Roman gods. America followed all the power of ancient Rome.

“And he doeth great wonders, so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men”: that was America. It wasn’t Spain and it wasn’t France; America dropped the atom bomb on Hiroshima and Nagasaki in August of 1945, World War II. Fire from heaven.

“And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast”: the miracle of calling fire from heaven, that great wonder, done in the sight of his other allies.

“Saying to them that dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast, which had the wound by a sword, and did live”: make an image in honor of Rome, which fell in 193 but came back alive in the Renaissance around 1453. That goes back to verse 8: once they conquered us it was easy for them to put up that image of Caesar Borgia as Christ, and to force us during slavery and colonialism to worship him. That image comes from Rome: Leonardo da Vinci was hired to paint Caesar Borgia, the second son of Alexander VI of Rome, as Jesus the Christ. You can see the sketches Leonardo did of him, the Renaissance Jesus.

“And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast”: they gave that image the life of Christ. They didn’t say, this is Caesar Borgia, worship him; they said this is Jesus Christ.

“That the image of the beast should both speak”: this goes back to Esau’s technology, his science. They find an actor who looks like Caesar Borgia, put him in their movies, and he quotes the words of Christ in his British accent. Now there is a video game where you play through the life of Jesus. This is war. The Jehovah’s Witnesses say nobody knows what Jesus looked like, and in their comic books you see a white man with the speech bubble, come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden.

“And cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed”: go back to verses 7 and 8. He made war with the twelve tribes, overcame us in slavery and colonialism, and if we didn’t worship, we were killed. That is how we became Christians, these modern-day Christians worshipping this false image. Verse 15 deals with his religion; from verse 16 down deals with his politics.

“And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond”: small nations and great nations, rich nations and poor nations, the free-world nations and the third-world nations.

“To receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads”: what is in your forehead? Your brain: they would teach a philosophy for us to believe. And in our right hands: we would support whatever they taught us. Their mark is their policies. This deals with their politics of economics.

The brothers came back from Uganda with money that equals about $200 American, a stack this thick, and went to exchange it. The exchange said we don’t do this here, take it to your bank; the bank said no. Maybe Uganda is on a list, but America is not exchanging their money. The IMF and the World Bank sit back in Washington DC and tell you how much your money is worth. Sierra Leone has the diamonds, and they tell them your money is garbage, it’s not worth anything, while they take everything; and the nations have to abide by that, or they get sanctioned and embargoed.

“And that no man might buy or sell”: buying and selling deals with trade, with commerce. That is the World Trade Organization, the IMF, the United States Department of Commerce, the US Treasury, the Federal Reserve, and subgroups under them: a system set up dealing with buying and selling.

“Save he that had the mark”: you had to follow their policies. What happens when you don’t accept America’s policies? You get sanctioned or embargoed. A sanction can be on an individual or on certain items; an embargo is on the entire country, and every nation is forbidden to do business with it. Look at the list today: Iran, Venezuela, Russia, Iraq, Bolivia, the Central African Republic, China, the Comoros, the Congo, Eritrea, Libya, Mauritania, South Sudan. What we read in the Bible we are witnessing in the news: America gets mad at a nation that will not abide by her policies and puts sanctions and embargoes on them.

“Or the name of the beast”: that is America. America is the head honcho; it’s not Britain, and it’s not the Vatican, whatever those blacks say.

Some people keep saying the mark is the RFID chip, radio frequency identification. That is a homing device; they put that in your dog and your cat when you lose them. It is not what this is talking about. Read it: the mark, or the name, or the number of his name. Three different things, or, or, or. If a day is coming when they round everybody up and stick a chip in you, why are there three options? Could you say, I don’t want the chip, just write your name on my forehead? To buy a pack of chicken do you have to say Esau? Underline or in your Bibles; they might remove it in the new Bibles. This destroys anything about a microchip. It is going into his philosophies, his doctrines, his policies and his articles.

“Here is wisdom. Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast: for it is the number of a man”: not an individual man, but a mankind, the white man. What man is this? Esau, Edom. “And his number is Six hundred threescore and six”: 666 represents Esau. That is Esau’s number, a number of destruction: six seals, six trumpets, six vials.

precepts.why: He exerciseth all the power of the first beast: Rome took this from Greece. “Moreover how they had made for themselves a senate house, wherein three hundred and twenty men sat in council daily, consulting alway for the people, to the end they might be well ordered.” A senate: Greece established it, Rome followed it, and America got it from Rome.

Don’t forget the thought. “For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets”: false prophets to substantiate the false Christ. “And shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.” Revelation 13:13-14 is saying the same thing: the great wonder of fire from heaven, August 1945, by which they deceive them that dwell on the earth, and then the image.

To reference the mark in the Bible, see what happened in the time of the Maccabees. Their policies were written in what are called articles. This is what Rome is telling Judas Maccabeus: “If there come first any war upon the Romans or any of their confederates throughout all their dominion, The people of the Jews shall help them, as the time shall be appointed, with all their heart: Neither shall they give any thing unto them that make war upon them, or aid them with victuals, weapons, money, or ships, as it hath seemed good unto the Romans”. Don’t aid them with food, weapons or money: that is key for Revelation 13. “But they shall keep their covenants”: their agreements.

“According to these articles did the Romans make a covenant with the people of the Jews.” It was all fluff, all lies, all deceit: when Greece came against them, Rome did not come and help. Judas Maccabeus and them knew that thing, so they didn’t fall for the lies. It is just like the treaties with the American Indians: sign this treaty, sign this treaty.

The mark of his name. “And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever”: this goes back to what Daniel said about that little horn being given to the burning flame. “And they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image”: the white man and his image, Christianity. “And whosoever receiveth the mark of his name”: is it a microchip with his name on it? No. It goes back to his philosophies, his doctrines and his policies, his articles that you subject yourself to.

In Uganda the Christians would say it doesn’t matter what Jesus you worship as long as you obey his teachings. But you can’t have another Jesus and have the true gospel; if you have a false Jesus you have a false gospel. This is for those who say it doesn’t matter if he’s black or white: “If any man worship the beast and his image”, any man that worships the white man and the white image of Jesus, “and receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand”, receives his philosophies and policies in his mind and supports them with his hands, “The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God”. He “shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb”. You are not going to escape: you will have no rest day nor night.

This goes with Revelation 14:9-11. “Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan”: remember, the dragon gave him his power and his seat. “With all power and signs and lying wonders”: those are the miracles of Revelation 13 and the wonders of Matthew 24, saying the same thing.

“And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish”: them appointed to die, talking about our people. “Because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved”: you don’t want to believe the Bible the way the Israelites are teaching it; you want modern-day Christianity. “And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie”: oh, Jesus healed me, Jesus take the wheel, when I prayed to white-man Jesus my rheumatism went away. Your belief is no longer based on the biblical writings; it is based on your feelings and on whatever thus saith the white man.

“That they all might be damned who believed not the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.” Damned is in the Bible; that is not cursing, that is what the scripture says. We ain’t got to keep no commandments, God’s laws are done away with: you, your mama and your daddy are going to be damned.

sense.text: “And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world”: remember Job 11:6, the secrets of wisdom are double. Christian commentaries read about the great dragon cast out and say it is a spiritual demon. No: this goes with the white man too. “And his angels were cast out with him”: his angels are his allies. Britain is going down with him.
“For the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our God day and night”: that is Satan, and the white man. Tell it on the news.

“And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb”: this is how we are going to overcome, brothers and sisters, by what Christ did for us. But you cannot be in the midst of sin saying I’m going to overcome because I believe on Jesus; it doesn’t work like that.

“And by the word of their testimony”: this is God’s testimony, not your personal testimony. Everybody has a testimony, and it’s malarkey: today you believe, tomorrow you are mad at the leadership and you leave. The testimony that is going to help us overcome is in Psalms 132. “And they loved not their lives unto the death.” We are going to overcome Satan, and we are going to overcome the beast.

precepts.why:
“If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony”: not your testimony, his testimony. “That I shall teach them”: and he teaches us from the Bible. “Their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore”: that is the only way our people are going to rule on this earth.

Verse 11 tells you what the testimony is. “The Lord hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.” What is the fruit of his body? Sperm. Christ came from the seed of David. That is the testimony God wants to hear: that the Messiah comes from the seed of David. That immaculate conception you’re running around with is garbage. We have to believe his covenant and the testimony regarding his son.

sense.text: “And that no man might buy or sell”: put this in your notes. This is not talking about a black man or a Latino in Harlem trying to buy a Snickers bar, or Tyrone or Raheem buying sneakers. It is talking about buying and selling on a major level, corporations and industries. Now, they are making RFID chips, but that is how they locate people; that is not what this is talking about.

precepts.why:
Here is the precept. “And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her”: over Babylon, over America. We don’t use the word merchants in modern English; the modern word is corporations, industries. “For no man buyeth their merchandise any more”.

What is their merchandise? “The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet”: all these things can be found on the continent of Africa; the island of Madagascar produces silk. And the last two words: “and slaves, and souls of men.”

From the beginning of the Renaissance era, the only ones that got involved with the slave trade are those that agreed with the policies that were being set up during that time. Those are the nations that got involved with all this buying and selling.

sense.text: For a long time there was no music for Israel to praise God with; you were listening to Drake, Lil Wayne, Nicki Minaj, all that garbage. As the music is put together and supported, this is what the Lord wants in it: “Sing praises to the Lord, which dwelleth in Zion”. Zion is us; Zion is where we are going to be delivered. “Declare among the people his doings”: the songs are supposed to declare among the people his doings. The worldly music declares you’re a hoe, you’re a thief, you hate your brother, you’re a gang banger, a drug dealer, an adulterer, all the nastiness.

“Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O Lord”: we are giving thanks unto the Most High through this music, for waking us up and giving us our nationality, our heritage and our culture. “Among the heathen”: the other nations that are watching us, hating us and trying to stop us. “And sing praises unto thy name.”

So how can you support somebody making music who attacked us before the heathen? There are people who went before the world, before the heathen, called us a cult, called us evil and a hate group, and condemned the movement, and now they are trying to put music out like they didn’t do anything. Any of you that buy that music or touch it go against everything we just read; you hate your nation, you are a hypocrite, and you deserve the judgment the Most High is going to bring. This is historic: we are fulfilling prophecy and trying to take the pollution from the people and build our nation back. That is who you support.
